lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task planning: budgeting and measurement

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to justify a modelling choice.

items.prompt: 156 chairs are shared equally among 12 tables. How many per table?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: 4 tickets cost $9.01 each and there is a $0.88 fee. What is the total cost?
A project uses 1/12 meter of blue ribbon and 7/12 meter of gold ribbon. How much ribbon is used?
A 1/4-meter path is scaled by 3. What is the new length in meters?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will model, why that model, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: A storage box is 3 units long, 2 units wide, and 6 units high. What is its volume in cubic units?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A data point is at (4, 5). Move right 2 and up 2. What is the new point?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A student says a 5 by 5 by 3 box has volume 13. Is the claim correct?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
